models.name: Zhang et al. 2017 (interactive)
models.description: Automatic, and reads painted hints as input. Small and quick, colours are muted.

models.name: Zhang et al. 2016
models.description: Automatic only, conservative and muted. Painted hints still apply afterwards.

models.name: DDColor (ModelScope weights)
models.description: 2023, ConvNeXt-L. Much more saturated and specific than the Zhang models; the authors' all-round pick. Needs the stabilizer on video.
models.license: unverified: the code is Apache-2.0, check the model card for the weights

models.name: DDColor (paper weights)
models.description: 2023, ConvNeXt-L, the weights from the paper. More conservative than the ModelScope weights.
models.license: unverified: the code is Apache-2.0, check the model card for the weights

models.name: DDColor (artistic weights)
models.description: 2023, ConvNeXt-L, trained for bolder, more vivid colour. Less faithful, more striking.
models.license: unverified: the code is Apache-2.0, check the model card for the weights

models.name: DDColor tiny
models.description: 2023, ConvNeXt-T. A quarter the size of DDColor-L and much faster, a little less accurate. The one to try on CPU.
